audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[].side was 'Skill' on all seven rows while content win[] read Skill/Galio/Galio/Galio/Annie/Annie/Galio, matching packet.levelChart. Six rows disagreed across layers.
audit.why: The content verdict is the defensible one: Galio wins 2 through 4-5 whenever Pyromania is unstacked, Annie takes 6 and first item off a stacked stun into Tibbers, and Galio outlasts with two items.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[1..6].side onto the content/packet verdict with ratings and whys rewritten in the same group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike rows were generic Galio boilerplate and never named the actual spike: Tibbers at 6 on a 130s cooldown, cast off a stocked Pyromania.
audit.why: Annie's power is a timer, not a level — four casts arm the stun and her whole kill pattern needs it.
audit.corrected: Rows 4 and 5 now say so; the cooldowns field carries the numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page stated the interaction that decides the lane: Pyromania stuns on the next offensive spell after four casts, and a stun landing on Galio mid-W-charge cancels the taunt before it releases.
audit.why: Shield of Durand is a charge, not an instant — Annie's stacked stun is the one thing in her kit that beats it, and her farming casts are what stack it.
audit.corrected: Written into tradeBad, breakdown.trading and the Do's/Don'ts.
